name: Knowledge intake: curated source to KB
description: Workflow skeleton for curated knowledge intake. The knowledge base is modeled as an information system; execution is assigned to business roles that may be backed by optional workers.

documents.name: Knowledge source discovery instruction
documents.content: Discover candidate source material for intake. Return sources, owner, provenance, access_constraints, and recommended next_action. Do not ingest secrets or private chat content.

documents.name: Knowledge source classification instruction
documents.content: Classify each source by domain, sensitivity, freshness, reliability, and target KB location. Return accepted_sources, rejected_sources, sensitivity_notes, and extraction_plan.

documents.name: Knowledge extraction instruction
documents.content: Extract reusable knowledge from accepted sources. Return normalized_notes, citations, tags, stale_claims, and review_questions.

documents.name: Knowledge review instruction
documents.content: Review extracted knowledge for correctness, source attribution, sensitivity, and duplication. Return approved:boolean, required_edits, publish_path, and reviewer_notes.

documents.name: Knowledge publishing instruction
documents.content: Publish approved knowledge into the curated KB path. Return published_path, changed_files, summary, and follow_up_maintenance.
